description: This file contains selector utility functions for memoization, dependency management, and structured selection in a Redux-based state management system, specifically for the Mattermost project.

methods.name: defaultEqualityCheck
methods.description: Checks if two arguments are strictly equal.

methods.name: areArgumentsShallowlyEqual
methods.description: Performs a shallow comparison of two argument arrays using a provided equality check.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Extracts and validates dependencies (functions) from input array for selector creation.

methods.name: createSelectorCreator
methods.description: Factory function to create custom selector functions with memoization.

methods.name: createStructuredSelector
methods.description: Creates a structured selector that maps state slices to an object based on provided selectors.
